openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}

        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}

        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/LineageOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/children:
    get:

      operationId: getSunidChildren
      summary: Seek-paginated child nodes

        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}

        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ChildrenOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/annotations:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidAnnotations

        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}

        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/AnnotationsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/images:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidImages
      summary: Thumbnail and larger static images for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ImagesOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/homology:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidHomology
      summary: Homology scope and warnings for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/HomologyOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/fatcat-chain-statistics:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidFatcatChainStatistics
      summary: Node-specific FATCAT chain-statistics classification consistency
      description: >

      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/FatcatChainStatisticsOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}

item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q004_ferritin_like_functional_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe release 2.08, ferritins, ribonucleotide-reductase-like proteins, and manganese catalases should be interpreted as remotely homologous members of the same ferritin-like superfamily, not as the same family or as automatically interchangeable enzymes. The shared hierarchy is class a, All alpha proteins; fold a.25, Ferritin-like; superfamily a.25.1, Ferritin-like, SUNID 47240. Within that superfamily SCOPe separates the named chemistries into distinct families: Ferritin, a.25.1.1, SUNID 47241; Ribonucleotide reductase-like, a.25.1.2, SUNID 47253; and Manganese catalase (T-catalase), a.25.1.3, SUNID 100951. SCOPe's homology metadata says homology is implied at the a.25.1 superfamily level, while the broader a.25 fold level by itself does not imply homology. Thus the different iron-storage/ferroxidase, ribonucleotide-reductase radical chemistry, and manganese-catalase peroxide chemistry are best treated as functional divergence within a homologous ferritin-like scaffold. Unsafe transfers: do not transfer exact enzymatic activity, metal specificity, active-site residues, oligomeric state, substrate chemistry, or annotation labels across these families solely from the common superfamily; those require independent external evidence such as conserved catalytic/metal-binding residues, bound cofactors/metals, biochemical assays, and phylogenetic or sequence-family context. For template use, a member of one family can support remote structural modeling of the ferritin-like core, but family-specific representatives should be chosen for functional annotation, and a ferritin representative should not be used as sole evidence that an RNR-like protein or manganese catalase has ferritin chemistry, or vice versa.","evidence_used":["/api/v1","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ferritin&mode=token&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ribonucleotide&mode=token&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=manganese%20catalase&mode=token&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47241","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47253","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/100951","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47239","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240/children?limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47239/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47241/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47253/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/100951/homology"]}]}
